claims.text: Generative AI models present specific challenges including hallucinations, harmful and manipulative content, and copyright infringement.
AI system evaluation and monitoring must include responsible AI dimensions such as robustness, bias, security, and interpretability beyond accuracy.

evidence.description: Generative AI models present additional challenges such as hallucinations, harmful and manipulative content, and copyright infringement.
It is essential to evaluate and monitor AI systems not only for accuracy and quality-related metrics but also for robustness, bias, security, interpretability, and other responsible AI dimensions.

methodologies.name: Literature Survey
methodologies.description: Surveys state-of-the-art approaches and open challenges in grounding and evaluating generative AI systems.

limitations.text: Open challenges remain in addressing harms associated with generative AI systems.
